t: The Infinity Nuke is a tool of mass destruction where explosion radius will increased based on the tier and the amount of biofuel in it. The Nuke won't destroy things in claimed chunks. $(br2)To make it explode you need to place it on the ground, right click it to arm it and right click it with a flint & steel to make it explode.
无限核弹是一种大规模毁灭工具，其爆炸半径会随等级以及其中生物燃料的数量而增加。核弹不会破坏已声明区块中的东西。$(br2)要让它爆炸，你需要先将其放在地上，右击进行武装，然后再用打火石右击它使其爆炸。
